integrity: The lower bound follows symbolically from h not exceeding g and from the nine-citation requirement for g at least three. The sharp four-paper layers are completely solved in integers and replayed by an exact enumeration script; finite computation is not used as evidence for the universal lower bound.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the standard paper-count-constrained g-index, integer citation counts, equal paper counts, and equal total citation counts. The unrestricted sharp layer permits zero-cited publications; a separate positive-citation boundary is therefore included. The result is an ordinal statement about bibliometric measures and does not assert that either index is a normatively preferable assessment of research quality.
title: Four papers and nine citations are the sharp h-index–g-index reversal boundary
